title: Two unrelated NPCs in different regions are both simply named 'Sela' and share near-identical description/interaction text (both 'doesn't look up first. Looks up eventually, and takes your measure quick,' both solved the same way: read the signs / press plainly / offer in trade). A player tracking NPCs or companions by name could easily conflate them.
where: Hearthlands / The Tally-Keeper's Cottage vs. Saltkerns / Sela's Hut
